additional_info.subject: 0424065 - ID0424065-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002516] SECC- Charger hardware is faulty CRM:00314000165
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Basheer,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID042406.
The ticket is related to charger
TOf9QH
, which is currently in failsafe mode.
The charger enters the failsafe mode whenever the communication to one of the vital controllers is permanently lost (routers, EcoGs, PLC). I connected to the charger remotely via SSH, and I discovered that the EcoG-Main KF11 is not communicating with the charger. The EcoG-LE KF12 is instead communicating correctly.
It is therefore necessary to go onsite and correct this HW defect.
I would suggest to go onsite with some spare ETH cables and a new EcoG-Main KF11, and:
First check if the issue is in the ETH cable, by replacing the ETH cable to the KF11 and verify the communication.
If the ETH is not defective, then please replace the EcoG KF11.
Looking forwrad to hearing your feedback soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
